comment: Curated notes merged into the generated inventory. The generator produces every ROW from the retrieved metadata; these carry the handful of facts that are not in the XML and would otherwise be destroyed on the next regeneration. Key format is '<MetadataType>|<member>', matching the package.xml member exactly. Text is appended to the component's generated description.

note: **Note the lower-case `c` in the API name** - a real typo, and load scripts must respect it.
**Composite key** `<contactExtId>|<applicationExtId>`, not a single Airtable `rec...` ID.
**Not flagged `externalId`, and it cannot be** - Salesforce forbids External ID fields on this object. The object is loaded by insert + read-then-diff rather than upsert.
**Populated by Flow - do not write directly.**
Roll-up Summary - Salesforce rejects direct writes.

Self-referential lookup - cannot resolve within its own upsert batch and needs a second pass.
Junction of Application and Contact via **two Lookups**, not Master-Detail - which is why it needs a duplicate-check Flow.
True junction with **two Master-Detail** relationships (Impediment and Opportunity), so both parents must exist first.
Master-Detail child of Account; represents the partner agreement.
